newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela reserves seen at $20 bln by end '97.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela reserves seen at $20 bln by end '97.

text.p: Venezuelan foreign reserves will grow $4 billion to reach $20 billion by the end of 1997, a senior government official said.

"With foreign investment, profit-sharing contracts in the oil sector and continuing strong oil prices, international reserves could reach $20 billion by the end of 1997," Fernando Hernandez, advisor to the Planning Ministry, told reporters in Congress.
"By the end of 1996, reserves should reach $16 billion," Hernandez said.
Foreign reserves hit $15.4 billion on November 25, according to figures from the Central Bank, up over $5.6 billion in the year thanks largely to higher-than-expected international oil prices.
